text:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The issue involves incorrect timing of the weekly summary email for users in different time zones. The file `src/notifications/rollup.ts` handles the scheduling and sending of weekly rollup emails and is the most appropriate place to fix the time zone logic causing the delay for Sydney users.
